npcs.name: Harbour Master Brenna
npcs.title: Quays
greeting: The founder watches every ship in. Mind the ropes.

quests.title: The Founder's Ledger
quests.offer: Read the plinth of the founder's statue and tell me the year it was raised.
quests.accept: The statue stands at the end of the quay.
quests.waiting: Have you found the plinth yet?
quests.thanks: Quite right. Take this for your trouble.

steps.text: Read the plinth of the founder's statue
